summary: Installer Disk list shares its width across the columns by weight and dragging a column divider resizes the column (BUG-0529); both wizards and nex-config read SATA/SAS/SCSI and virtio disk serials, not only NVMe (BUG-0530).

guide.reason: GUI Disk step notes the column spread, that a header divider can be dragged to resize a column, and which disks report a serial.

api.reason: Local Debian installer GUI only; no Controller/Core API.

state.reason: Installer presentation only; no durable pool or Controller state.

verification.method: python3 tests/integration/installer-disk.py (real disk list allocated under Xvfb at 1280x1024; default spread asserted; Model, Serial and Device dividers dragged with xdotool; serial helper run against NVMe, virtio, VPD-only, empty-page and Xen sysfs trees); python3 tests/integration/installer-text-wizard.py (VPD-only mirror partner and virtio-style disk listed and recorded); installer-shell/handoff/qol/keyboard/hostname/link harnesses; bash installer/check.sh. Native BMC-console capture and real SATA/SAS serial readout against a rebuilt ISO not run.
